name: qkd_seq_xd_sel

pin_regs.reason: The tile IS one pin register: x_d <= q_v ? q_d : k_d; the output pin is a flop and every input reaches that flop through one 2:1 select. Extra input registers would add an edge to both the Q and the KVN store push for no timing need (128 flops, one mux level).

structural_change: first build: 128-b store-data select of qkd_seq_static_p (x4, hardened once), Q data from the attention programme or the KVN receiver word, one output register. Pin-limited bridge sized to its faces: 43.2 x 21.6 (N 257 pins = 5.9/um, S 128 = 3/um); logic is 128 flops + 128 mux.

job.purpose: KVE-2/SEQ 10-17 (0cx (3)): store-data select leaf of qkd_seq_static_p; bench = the parent bench (seq_static_prg_bench.sh) incl. the xd_sel select mutant (MUT 5) which FAILs.
